input.quote: a. Grant. TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: The grant runs to Client alone: neither affiliates nor contractors acting on our behalf are named and there is no mechanism to add them, and §15 conditions transfer on the other party's consent with only an affiliate carve-out and no successor/M&A exception, so the clause fails even the fallback. The licence term in §2(c) also says nothing about paid-up licences being perpetual and irrevocable or limiting termination of a subscription licence to uncured material breach. The redline takes the preferred position with three tight edits: extend the licensee scope in the grant, add one short sentence on perpetual/irrevocable paid-up licences and termination only for uncured material breach, and add a successor carve-out to the assignment consent.

ops.oldText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables
ops.newText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client and its affiliates and contractors acting on Client's behalf a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables

ops.text: Licenses for which Client has paid in full are perpetual and irrevocable, and any subscription license may be terminated by TrueLink only for Client's uncured material breach.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the grant to our affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, confirmed that fully paid-up licences are perpetual and irrevocable and that a subscription licence ends only for uncured material breach, and added a successor-transfer carve-out in §15.
proposal.summary: Extend licence to Client affiliates and contractors, make paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable with termination only for uncured material breach, and permit successor transfer

mappings.element: Licence extended to contractors acting on Customer's behalf.
Subscription licences terminable only for uncured material breach.
